reason: B proposes the more physically credible mechanism: accelerated oxidation, salt-assisted scale disruption, porosity, and spallation are plausible for low-alloy Q235 at 700–900 °C, whereas A unjustifiably assumes a pre-existing Fe3O4-rich native film remains protective across both regimes. B is testable and bounded, although it needs salt-free temperature controls and separate measurements of gross mass change, spalled material, and descaled metal loss to isolate salt fluxing and avoid misinterpreting oxidation mass gain.
